verdict.rationale: Namecheap's first-party Go SDK documents checking availability of one or more domains and listing all supported TLDs, so availability lookup exists as a product capability. Nothing in the pack shows how fast the search is, any alternate-TLD suggestion feature, or any policy or practice against front-running searched names. Missing for 10: evidence of instant/fast search results, alternate TLD suggestions, a commitment or independent evidence against lookup-then-squat, and a consumer-facing search UI.

support.subject: As a founder, domain search is fast and honest — instant availability, alternate TLD suggestions, and no lookup-then-squat games on names I searched
